overview: PredNext enhances unsupervised spiking neural networks by introducing a plug-and-play cross-view temporal prediction module that enforces future feature prediction to improve temporal consistency and semantic representation.

modules.name: Video Temporal Sampling Loader
modules.description: Handles the dataset logic for sampling current video clips and subsequently sampled clips from the same video, supporting variable temporal lengths and sampling strides required for next-clip prediction.

modules.name: Dual-View Augmentation Pipeline
modules.description: Applies spatial and photometric transformations to generate two distinct augmented views of the video clips, serving as the foundation for the cross-view prediction and contrastive objectives.

modules.name: Spiking Residual Backbone
modules.description: Implements the deep spiking neural network architecture using residual connections, featuring spiking neuron dynamics with membrane potential accumulation and firing mechanisms.

modules.name: Temporal Feature Aggregator
modules.description: Aggregates features across timesteps by computing the time-averaged representation of the spiking outputs, bridging the temporal dynamics of SNNs with static representation vectors.

modules.name: Self-Supervised Baseline Frameworks
modules.description: Adapts standard contrastive and non-contrastive learning frameworks (SimCLR, MoCo, BYOL, SimSiam, BarlowTwins) to the spiking neural network architecture, computing the base self-supervised loss.

modules.name: PredNext Predictor Heads
modules.description: Implements the separate multi-layer perceptron prediction heads for the Step Predictor and the Clip Predictor, mapping current representations to future temporal spaces.

modules.name: Cross-View Prediction Loss
modules.description: Calculates the divergence between predicted features from one view and target future features from the alternate view, utilizing cosine similarity with stop-gradient operations to prevent representation collapse.

modules.name: Combined Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the joint optimization loop, balancing the base self-supervised loss and the auxiliary prediction loss, and coordinating the forward passes for current and future clips.

modules.name: Downstream Fine-Tuning Engine
modules.description: Implements the evaluation pipeline for action recognition, handling the initialization with pretrained weights, classifier head attachment, and supervised training on target datasets.

modules.name: Video Retrieval Evaluator
modules.description: Performs nearest-neighbor search on aggregated feature representations to compute Recall metrics at various thresholds, assessing the semantic discriminability of the learned features.

modules.name: Temporal Consistency Analyzer
modules.description: Computes the temporal feature consistency error by measuring the average cosine distance between representations of the same video across different timesteps, tracking it throughout training.

modules.name: Ablation & Component Controller
modules.description: Configures and executes ablation experiments by selectively toggling the Step Predictor, Clip Predictor, and switching between cross-view and same-view prediction strategies.

modules.name: High-Dimensional Feature Visualizer
modules.description: Applies dimensionality reduction techniques to feature embeddings for manifold visualization and generates qualitative grids for video retrieval results.

modules.name: Distributed Training & Optimization Utilities
modules.description: Provides infrastructure for multi-GPU synchronization, custom learning rate scheduling with warmup, mixed-precision training, and model checkpointing.
